She leaves "it to the representative to work out what your plan needs, and you are fine with them making the changes it takes on their side"; anything to be signed personally "you want handed to you". ### Counter-proofs
- "Do only what she asked": signing a lowered installment on the un-recomputed plan is excluded by the root prerequisite sentence; recomputing on a past-due plan or before the pause is excluded by the two recompute sentences.
- Paying arrears instead of re-age: excluded by the persona (cannot pay) and only re-age leaves "active … with no missed installment".
- Fall-back numbers (no factor): re-age 24+1 → held to 24; pause window to handling date → 3 considered, allowance 2 → 24+2 held to 24 (with 27 current: 27); recompute 24+6 → held to 24, −4 paid −0 = 20 → 3223.98/20 = 161.20 (floor 75); lowest installment with current 161.20: 100% share → 161.20 (no lowering). All differ from 27/31/74.98/62.00.
- Factor findability (record words → doc): 'Recurring Outpatient Therapy Account' (encounter variant) → latest_added_care; household_fpl_pct 187.6 on the pending_documents case → every "screened at or below 200 percent" doc; MEDICAID_SCREENING_REFERRAL notice → "BadgerCare Plus screening referral notice" docs (KB_search "Medicaid screening referral notice" returns them first; the KB never uses the word Medicaid — reader must know BadgerCare Plus is Wisconsin Medicaid); installment entry #4 of 75.00 → partial-entry docs; add-on enrollment dates → add-on frequency doc. No computation document hinted at a variation, except the generic "Order" sentences noted in the policy_kb file.
- Open point for comparison: B/C relative order is not fixed by any visible sentence; the intermediate term_months differ by order (27/31 vs 28/31) while the final state is identical.
